outputBytes.why: The last 64 KiB of each of stdout and stderr is kept: enough for an error and its context, bounded so a noisy command cannot fill memory or the session.

timeoutMs.why: A recipe that sets no timeoutMs of its own stops after 10 minutes: long enough for ordinary commands, short enough that a hung command does not hold the session.

maxTimeoutMs.why: No recipe may wait longer than 24 hours, whatever its timeoutMs says.

killDelayMs.why: After the terminate signal a command has 5 seconds to clean up before it is killed.
